generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A previously ready result-only handoff is treated as reusable after the remote branch advances through one or more material commits, so the certificate no longer names the current material candidate.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Trust a stored ready certificate or the writer identity instead of re-reading remote head, parent and changed paths before deciding whether handoff-only recovery is safe.
trigger_signals: remote head differs from published handoff head
current parent differs from certified material head
generalized_learning.reusable_control: HANDOFF-DRIFT-001: re-read remote lineage and classify recovery solely from certified material identity, parent and changed paths.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After any observed remote-head drift, require writer-agnostic identity reclassification and post-write-refreeze whenever the certified material SHA is no longer the material candidate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independent preflight must distinguish stale result-only handoff from stable-material handoff-only recovery and require refreeze when parent or material paths prove drift.

transfer_cases.procedure: Synthetic ready handoff followed by an unrelated external material commit.
Synthetic ready handoff followed by CI remediation that changes product/test files.
transfer_cases.observed: Terminal latch blocks green until a new material freeze and result-only child exist.

skill_changes.evidence: Writer-agnostic handoff recovery classifier and universal post-write refreeze contract tests passed.
Governed handoff latch blocks green after material drift regardless of writer; focused contract tests passed.
Stale handoff recovery classification distinguishes post-write-refreeze from handoff-only; focused contract tests passed.
